# The Laurel Room

> An event venue for 50–125 guests opening in Brampton, Ontario in 2027. Outside catering welcome — bring your own caterer, no food minimum. Pricing published as ranges.

## About
The Laurel Room is an event venue being created for celebrations of 50 to 125 guests in Brampton, Ontario, opening in 2027. Founded by Khushbu Dhahan. It exists because Brampton families kept having to choose between a banquet hall built for 300 with a mandatory in-house menu, and a community centre. The venue operates a bring-your-own-caterer model and publishes its pricing.

The space itself has not been secured yet, and the website deliberately does not describe a building that does not exist — no floor plans, no renders, and only one photograph, shown as a reference for the feeling rather than as the venue.

## Key facts
- Location: Brampton, Ontario, Canada
- Capacity: 50–125 guests
- Catering: bring your own — any caterer, any cuisine. No in-house menu, no food minimums.
- Pricing: published as two-sided ranges, $900–$6,200 depending on package and day of week, plus 13% HST. Ranges rather than fixed prices because no space has been leased yet — the building decides the number.
- Opening: 2027
- Founder: Khushbu Dhahan
- Phone: 647-286-1161 (call or text)
- Email: hello@thelaurelroom.ca
- Instagram: @thelaurelroom
- Website: https://thelaurelroom.ca

## Packages
All prices plus 13% HST. Setup, strike, cleaning and a site rep are inside the package price.

| Package | Mon–Thu | Fri–Sun |
|---|---|---|
| The Space (one 5.5-hour block) | $1,200–$1,500 | $1,600–$2,200 |
| The Styled Experience (one block, styled) | $2,300–$2,700 | $2,800–$3,800 |
| The Full Celebration (full day + coordinator) | $3,800–$4,400 | $4,500–$6,200 |

Signature packages: The Mehndi Night (Friday or Saturday evening) $3,000–$4,200 · The Morning Celebration $1,400–$2,000 · The Corporate Retreat (Mon–Thu, four hours) $1,100–$1,500 · The Short Block (Mon–Thu only, four hours) $900–$1,200.

A useful anchor: most 100-guest Saturday evenings land between $3,200 and $4,300 all in, HST included.

Add-on prices are exact, because they do not depend on the building.

## Booking blocks
Daytime 10:00 AM–3:30 PM · evening 5:30 PM–11:00 PM · full day 10:00 AM–11:00 PM. A morning booking and an evening booking can happen on the same day.

## The five looks
Design directions chosen before a space is signed, included with The Styled Experience and up: Laurel (sage, cream, eucalyptus) · Golden Hour (amber light, brass, candles) · Blush (dusty pink, cream, rose gold) · Monochrome (black, white, silver, acrylic) · Regal (jewel tones, gold, crystal).

## Events
Mehndi nights and sangeets, nikkahs and intimate weddings, baby and bridal showers, aqiqahs and naming ceremonies, milestone birthdays, engagement parties, Diwali and Eid gatherings, corporate days.

## Founding families
A free early list, capped at 30 dates. Founding families lock their price at the top of the published band for their day, get first pick of the calendar, and are invited to see the space before it opens. Anyone who joined while a 10% discount was advertised keeps that instead.
